items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: he said, Blakey 'Well, man, Art Baker just come back in town.' So I said, 'Well, I got to catch that band, you know.' So we go out the Stage Door

ctx.x: Then I went out of town with Leo. We went down to Rock Island for a week -- one of them little joints down there. And I came back in town, and I had a gig with Ira Sullivan Art Solomon, somewhere -- I forgot where, and he said, Blakey "Well, man, Art Baker just come back in town." So I said, "Well, I got to catch that band, you know."

So we go out the Stage Door -- a place called the Stage Door Lounge; 63rd and Blackistone. These were all nightclubs, and I had a chance to listen to the great Lou Buhaina Ayman -- that was a beautiful man.
